body:
## Pull request overview

This PR significantly expands the playground demonstrations by adding 23 new examples across 6 new categories (Dashboards, Basic, Feedback, Disclosure) and enhancing existing categories (Forms, Data Display, Complex). The additions showcase component capabilities through production-ready, schema-driven JSON configurations that demonstrate Object UI's Tailwind-native approach.

**Changes:**
- Added 3 professional dashboard demonstrations (Analytics, E-commerce, Project Management)
- Introduced 4 basic component demos (Typography, Image Gallery, Icon Showcase, Separator)
- Created 3 feedback component examples (Loading states, Progress indicators, Skeleton loading)
- Added 2 disclosure examples (Accordion FAQ, Collapsible sections)
- Enhanced Forms category with 5 new demos
- Expanded Data Display with 6 new examples
- Extended Complex category with 3 additional demos

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 34 out of 34 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples.ts | Central registry updated to include all new categories and example keys |

| apps/playground/src/data/examples/dashboards/*.json | Three comprehensive dashboard JSON schemas showcasing gradient designs and rich components |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/basic.ts | New registry for 4 basic component demonstrations |

| apps/playground/src/data/examples/disclosure/*.json | Two disclosure schemas for accordions and collapsible sections |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/forms.ts | Enhanced with 5 new form demonstration entries |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/forms/*.json | Five new form schemas for controls, date pickers, file upload, OTP input, and toggles |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/data-display.ts | Expanded with 6 new data display entries |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/data-display/*.json | Six new schemas for alerts, badges, avatars, lists, markdown, and tree views |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/complex.ts | Enhanced with 3 additional complex component entries |
| apps/playground/src/data/examples/complex/*.json | Three new schemas for carousel, timeline, and basic table components |
